quote: FY2022 10-K BS: "Common stock, par value $0.01: 3,200 shares authorized; 1,758 shares issued and 1,300 shares outstanding at December 31, 2022" (shares in millions); "Treasury stock, at cost: 458 and 422 shares at December 31, 2022 and 2021" (1,758 - 458 = 1,300). Cover: "As of February 1, 2023, the registrant had 1,284,111,667 shares of common stock outstanding" (a later date, after the ~17.4 million share ASR receipt of January 4, 2023). FY2023 10-K and 2023 10-Qs reprint 1,300 for Dec. 31, 2022
rule_proposal: no exact (unrounded) count at Dec. 31, 2022 is printed in any 10-K or 10-Q: 1,300 million is the finest figure for that date; the exact cover count is for Feb. 1, 2023 and must not be served for Dec. 31, 2022 (it reflects the Jan. 4, 2023 ASR). Keep 1,300,000,000
